_meta.description: Canonical single-run output for the MiLT pipeline. All numbers derived from a single clf.predict_proba call (float64). Canonical band count, TV values, and p-value formula.

al_baselines.note: Coreset = k-center greedy on BioCLIP embedding space (float64); BADGE_approx = k-center greedy on LR gradient embedding (PCA-20 projected, K=19 classes → 380-dim); review order = most informative/diverse first. p-value formula: (n_exceed+1)/(N_PERM+1) [Phipson & Smyth 2010].

coreset.note: Bootstrap CI on AUC(A) - AUC(B). Positive gap = A achieves higher AUC. CI excludes 0 → significant at alpha=0.05.

badge_approx.note: Bootstrap CI on AUC(A) - AUC(B). Positive gap = A achieves higher AUC. CI excludes 0 → significant at alpha=0.05.

rare_recall_by_band.rare_definition: true label not in COMMON and not '誤検出(動物なし)'

0.note_tv_shannon: p = P(random ≤ confidence_order); lower TV/Shannon is better
0.note_spearman: p = P(random ≥ confidence_order); higher Spearman is better

mc_dropout_triage.description: MC-Dropout entropy triage using a 2-layer MLP (512→256→19, Dropout=0.2) trained on BioCLIP embeddings (same training split as LR canonical classifier). MC passes=15, seed=42. Compares: (a) LR confidence order, (b) LR predictive entropy order, (c) MC-Dropout MLP entropy order. Note: exp5/train_finetune.py ViT-B is 5-class open-set detector and cannot be reused for 19-class triage.

lr_confidence.description: LR max softmax probability ordering (least-confident first)

mc_dropout_entropy.description: MC-Dropout MLP predictive entropy ordering (highest-entropy first)

mc_dropout_triage.interpretation: If MC-Dropout entropy AUC ≈ LR confidence AUC, the ordering effect is robust to model choice / uncertainty estimator. If inferior, the concern that 'simpler confidence is not reliable' may warrant further investigation.

unknown_exclusion_sensitivity.description: Rare species definition with '不明' excluded. Rare = true not in COMMON, not '誤検出(動物なし)', not '不明'. Tests whether high-confidence misclassifications persist for genuine novel species (excluding the ambiguous '不明' category).

partial_auc_b30.description: Partial AUC computed over practical budget range B∈{0,5,10,20,30}%. This isolates performance in the realistic low-budget regime where researchers can only review a fraction of the data.

badge_vs_conf_rare_gap.description: Bootstrap 95% CI on rare recall AUC: BADGE_approx − confidence ordering. Positive gap = BADGE achieves higher rare recall AUC. BADGE_approx = k-center greedy on LR gradient embedding (PCA-20 projected, K=19 classes → 380-dim).
